description: What an advertised savings rate or bank bonus pays after its conditions and tax, beside a plain account with no conditions on the same money: the result in the words "Pays more", "Pays less" or "About the same", the dollars kept a year, every condition (balance cap, minimum balance, direct deposit, promo months, states excluded, end date), the provider's page and the date its terms were read. With no offer named, lists the offers on file. Use for "what's the catch with this 5% rate", "what does this bank bonus really pay".

balance.description: Cash balance in U.S. dollars. Needed with an offer.

federal_pct.description: Top federal income tax bracket, e.g. 24. Needed with an offer.

niit.description: True if the 3.8% net investment income tax applies.

offer.description: Offer name, provider or id (from the list this tool returns with no offer). Leave out to list the offers.

state.description: Two-letter U.S. state the person lives in, e.g. "NY". Some offers exclude states. Optional.

state_pct.description: State + local income tax rate, e.g. 5. 0 if none. Needed with an offer.

name: check_offer
title: Check an advertised savings rate or bank bonus
